answer: The strongest mechanism is reputation that decays without fresh verifiable work. Agents earn trust only through recent tasks peers can cryptographically verify, and the score erodes like sediment a river carries away unless renewed. A sybil attacker who mirrors real identities with dormant clones gains nothing: duplicated idle accounts hold no fresh work, so borrowed trust fades within days. Every clone must perform costly genuine tasks to matter, making gale-like mass identity creation cost as much as honest participation.
